name: awning-roll-bag

references.role: our approved awning roll kit (the same roll): match its colours, outline weight, shading and finish
our approved camp piece seen from above: match its outline weight, shading and finish only; do not copy its shape

art_plan.part: a rolled awning in its bag, strapped to a vehicle's side rail, seen from directly above, alone
art_plan.ships_as: laid by script along each of our vehicles' side rails, and across a roof for a packed rear tent (Vehicles 0.105.0)
art_plan.why: the lifted roll carried a fringe of the vehicle it was lifted from; drawn alone on white so the sprite exporter gives clean edges (the owner's review of 22 Nov 2026)

prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite part: a rolled canvas awning in its zipped bag, seen from directly above, lying horizontally. Image 1 is our approved awning roll: match its colours, outline weight, shading and finish. Image 2 is our camp gear seen from above, for style only.

Draw ONLY the bag, alone and centred on a plain pure white background: one long slim rounded tube running from the left edge to the right edge of the canvas, about one eighth as tall as it is long, in mid-grey canvas with a zip seam along its length, three narrow black straps around it spaced evenly, and plain rounded end caps.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No vehicle, rail, brackets, people, text, letters, numbers, logos, shadow outside the object, perspective or tilt.
